C1840.title: Developer Built Software for Black-Market "User-Funneling," Tech "Guru" Sentenced
C1840.summary: A technician developed specialized software to provide "user-funneling" services for black-market gangs, using automation tools to batch-add friends and push marketing messages, helping gangs precisely acquire targets for downstream fraud. In October 2025, Procuratorial Daily reported that the tech "guru" was held criminally liable for developing and selling funneling software that yielded hundreds of thousands of yuan in illegal profit. The case is typical of cracking down on the technical-support tier of black-market operations and holding software developers criminally accountable.
